Services

Built to keep your calendar busy.

You handle the dogs. We handle the scrolls, searches, clicks and numbers.

01 / SOCIAL

Social that earns attention

Content strategy, Reels, and campaigns that turn scrolling pet parents into loyal brand advocates—not just generic followers.

Thumb-Stopping Creative Production

We produce high-energy Reels, TikToks, street interviews, and native pet content designed to capture human attention in a crowded feed.

Proprietary Pet Creator Network

Tap into over 40,000+ vetted micro-influencers and pet parents to scale word-of-mouth trust and generate authentic user-generated content (UGC).

Community Management with a Pulse

We don’t just post and ghost. We engage with pet parents in the comments, run interactive stories, and build a highly active online pack around your brand.

02 / LOCAL

Be the brand they find first

Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and high-intent search visibility to dominate your local market.

Local SEO & Hyper-Targeted Visibility

We optimize your digital footprint by service areas and ZIP codes, ensuring you show up exactly where your ideal customers live and search.

Google Business Profile & Map Pack Domination

We audit, optimize, and actively manage your local map listings to capture ready-to-book pet parents the second they search for nearby care.

AI Search & Reputation Management

We position your facility to rank prominently in AI-driven search results (AEO/GEO) while automating review generation to build bulletproof local trust.

03 / PAID

Ads with a job to do

Meta and Google campaigns built strictly around bookings, memberships, and measurable customer acquisition.

Intent-Driven Paid Search (Google Ads)

We build campaigns structured by specific services (boarding, daycare, grooming, training) to target high-intent searches. No vanity clicks, just booked stays.

Paid Social Scale (Meta & TikTok)

We run and optimize targeted paid campaigns, using rigorous creative variations and audience testing to maximize your budget and scale acquisition.

Whitelisting & Creator Boosting

We amplify top-performing creator and influencer content through paid whitelisting, leveraging social proof to drive highly cost-effective conversions.

04 / CONVERT

Turn traffic into booked stays

Landing pages, conversion optimization, and tracking that directly connect your marketing spend to real revenue.

Conversion-Optimized Landing Pages

We build high-converting, service-specific landing pages designed for immediate action, reducing booking friction and maximizing your ad spend.

End-to-End Analytics & Growth Reporting

Track what actually matters: Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), new customer cost-per-lead, voicemail rates, and the direct impact of campaigns on your occupancy.

Intake Analysis & Call Tracking

We implement AI-driven call evaluation and CRM tracking to uncover missed opportunities, bridge front-desk gaps, and ensure no lead goes unhandled.

The Pawsitive Growth Funnel

Paws on the Pulse: How We Are Filling Dog Daycare Playrooms in October 2026

At PawfectlyDigital, we don’t just talk about growth - we map it out.

As a marketing agency dedicated entirely to dog daycare centers, hotels, and boarding facilities, our focus is simple: helping amazing pet care brands attract busy pet parents and fill their facilities to maximum capacity. Here is a look behind the curtain at our own strategic roadmap for October 2026, showing exactly how we transform online attention into thriving B2B client partnerships.

Our Core Focus

Helping Pet Brands Stand Out

The pet care industry runs on trust. Pet parents only choose facilities that feel safe, professional, and visible when they need them most.

At PawfectlyDigital, we help dog daycares and pet stay brands build that trust through hyper-local SEO, engaging social content, and clear communication that turns attention into enquiries.

Our audience includes daycare founders, kennel managers, and pet care entrepreneurs who want to fill capacity, strengthen local visibility, and grow with confidence.

The Immediate Milestone
1

new paying pet care client by October 31, 2026.

To hit this mark, we are combining high-value content publishing with highly customized, direct outreach to facility owners who need immediate support with their local visibility. Every proposal we send is individually tailored to the specific competitive landscape of that daycare's city.

Where We Drive Visibility

Three core channels. One bigger mission.

We focus our energy across three core channels, making sure every piece of content serves a distinct operational purpose:

📸

Instagram & Facebook

This is our creative playground. We share visual case studies, breakdown successful pet-industry ad campaigns, and engage directly with local pet care communities to prove what we can build for them.

🎬

TikTok

Our educational hub. We post snappy, actionable marketing tips specifically for pet professionals, offering quick wins that instantly improve their organic reach.

💼

LinkedIn

Our B2B networking space. We connect directly with dog daycare franchise executives and facility directors to discuss high-level marketing trends, scalable acquisition models, and long-term industry growth.

In parallel, we continuously optimize our website copy to capture high-intent searches from owners actively looking for pet business growth partners.

The Blueprint

Our Customer Journey

We track our client acquisition through a carefully monitored, realistic conversion funnel. Here is how casual interest scales into a formal partnership:

01

Discovery

1,000 targeted website visitors driven by organic content and search.

02

Connection

30 inbound enquiries via our contact forms (a steady 3% conversion rate).

03

Qualification

9 Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) that perfectly match our agency's core expertise.

04

Consultation

3 strategic discovery calls to map out timelines, budgets, and local goals.

05

Partnership

1 finalized contract (representing a successful 33% close rate from our consultations).

Note: These benchmarks serve as intentional operational targets for our team, allowing us to accurately measure our baseline performance and adjust our outreach velocity as the month progresses.
Setting the Standard

For Long-Term Collaboration

Signing a contract is just the first step. For PawfectlyDigital, true success lies in sustainable, long-term retention. We ensure our client relationships stay strong through a commitment to absolute transparency:

Tailored Local Execution

Marketing blueprints built around your specific neighborhood and competitor density.

Open-Book Reporting

Clear, monthly data reviews highlighting leads generated, cost per acquisition, and clear next steps.

Proactive Campaigning

Developing seasonal promotions ahead of major holidays to keep your kennels consistently booked.

Continuous Feedback Loops

Regular strategy check-ins to realign our marketing efforts with your changing facility capacity.

Our Promise

Trust built into every local strategy

We don’t make empty promises. Every local SEO strategy is tailored to the competitive density of your neighborhood, so your dog hotel or daycare has the strongest possible chance to appear first in nearby searches.

The Growth Metrics We Monitor

Data guides every creative choice we make.

To keep our agency moving in the right direction, we constantly benchmark our performance against these specific conversion indicators:

Traffic Acquisition

Increasing highly qualified organic visits to our insight pages.

Inbound Conversion Rate

Maintaining a 2–3% visitor-to-lead ratio.

Lead Qualification Rate

Ensuring at least 30% of enquiries represent ideal-fit businesses.

Proposal Success Rate

Converting roughly one-third of our strategy calls into active partnerships.

Final Objective

Welcoming a minimum of 1 new dedicated partner to our pack by October 31, 2026.

By combining structured data tracking with an approachable, expert online presence, we are growing PawfectlyDigital in a reliable, highly sustainable way.
